task_objective: Implement docs/plans/2026-08-22_headless-query-cli.md: a GUI-free DuckDB query-to-file CLI with source/output safety checks.
tests_added: Subprocess import guards prove registry, catalog, and headless query imports do not load PyQt6 or PySpark; SettingsService remains a lazy-compatible package export.
Active DuckDB adapter JSON Lines registration produces separate typed columns and rejects unsupported suffixes instead of guessing CSV.
Headless runner covers parsed aliases, resolved input/output identity, duplicate safety, one-statement normalization, adapter lifecycle, output preservation, and a real CSV export.
CLI coverage verifies grammar, typed option construction, formats, outputs, exit codes, legacy dispatch, and a subprocess with unusable Qt configuration.
design_decisions: Only SettingsService became lazy in wherewolf.services; every other existing package export remains eager and import-compatible.

The headless runner builds a request-scoped EngineKind.DUCKDB request from CatalogService aliases and calls the existing adapter export_full path, preserving streaming CSV/Parquet export and atomic replacement.
Dataset and destination paths are resolved before identity comparisons, so a symlink cannot turn an output into an input dataset under --force.
StatementService validates cardinality; the runner removes only the final separator at the validated statement span, retaining literal and comment semicolons.
The CLI catches expected query boundary errors without catching argparse SystemExit, retaining exit 2 for grammar errors.
